chunks: 3052 - Wuhayb ibn Hafs narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"A cow or a camel suffices for seven individuals, whether they are from one household or from different ones."

key_terms.الْبَدَنَةُ: a camel used as a sacrificial animal
key_terms.الْبَقَرَةُ: a cow used as a sacrificial animal
key_terms.تُجْزِيَانِ: they suffice or are valid on behalf of

ai.seo_question: Can a cow or camel be shared by seven people for a sacrificial offering?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning sacrificial offerings, stating that a cow or a camel may suffice on behalf of seven people. The ruling applies whether those individuals belong to the same household or to different households, indicating permissibility of shared participation.
